digest.component_or_area: external integration tier, LLM workflow execution and plan review DET floor
propositions: test_single_turn_live_structured_output fails with workflow status 'failed' because the test writes live-verdict.md to working tree but never commits it; snapshot-gated code re-roots to HEAD and cannot find the uncommitted prompt file

test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict observes llm_ran=False because the plan fixture lacks a Testing section, causing p10_verification_presence to fail and trigger the DET-floor short-circuit that returns BLOCK without calling the LLM tier
both test failures are defects in the test code itself, not in the product: the tests' docstrings claim they prove live execution, but the tests were dead guards that could never pass
the double-masking was caused by bug 8070 SnapshotRefError preventing the external tier from reaching the actual test failures until the snapshot resolution fix landed
DET floor P10 landed on 2026-07-30 with stricter requirements; the live test fixture last updated 2026-06-27 was stale and silently failed the new clarity checks
